source_policy: 同名转攻为守枪/格斗按攻击转防，卢按受伤20%转防，乾坤枪增打击/卢1级1.5%而连击末击0.5%原职责及数值保留；概率/锚/时长/高级线性与试算时点为项目采用。

attack_to_guard.trigger: first actual hostile direct root HP loss, receiver survives, once/action; no periodic/self/derived trigger
attack_to_guard.snapshot: nonfeedback own ordinary attack lower bound excluding all attack-defense conversions, final overrides and downstream rage/weakening/transfer
attack_to_guard.changes: both own attack endpoints subtract same transfer_amount, ordinary defense adds same amount; valid lower remains>=0, interval width preserved
attack_to_guard.stacking: one own source, new success replaces amount/duration no addition; other actor cannot donate copies

incoming20percent_to_guard.trigger: eligible root direct hit after hit/crit/accepted damage modifiers known, target alive, before ordinary defense application
incoming20percent_to_guard.preview_damage: floor(raw_before_defense100/(100+current ordinary+contextDefense excluding own prior transfer-family effect)); preview not committed HP loss and no callbacks/absorptions
incoming20percent_to_guard.final_current_hit: replace own transfer source then evaluate raw original event once with updated ordinary defense; later flat/percent/shield/barrier stages once; no iterative damage-defense convergence
incoming20percent_to_guard.already_active_source: old own contribution excluded from preview, successful new source replaces not stacks; failed chance keeps old contribution for actual hit
incoming20percent_to_guard.temporary_grade_change: source amount is activation snapshot, underlying effect eligibility must positive; no extra draw/refresh when anti changes grade

spear_flat_martial_power.scope: root attack martial flat skillpower component only, not basic/weapon/range/status/heal

lu_split_martial_power.source_first_two_levels: 1:1.5/0.5percent,2:3/1percent; continuation beyond2 explicit project linear extrapolation
lu_split_martial_power.scope: flat skillpower modifier only, use explicit combo_skill/finishing flags; if either true select lower coefficient once, not both
lu_split_martial_power.malformed_flags: reject formal phase, never inspect name or actual hits to guess

stat_graph: all attack-defense conversion inputs read declared pre-conversion anchors; pure flat skills feed skillpower stage not ordinary attack. Reversible snapshot sources expire/remove and recompute, no permanent base rewrites. New cycles/SCC reject before play, no default0 iteration fix.
persistence: per source activation amount/grade/remaining1..180 and hit trial/final receipt kept; preview arithmetic does not consume second damage RNG or reward. Root replay never re-draw/recompute with new target stats; death clears timed transfer but cooldown/action receipts remain.
scope: class-specific named rules only. They do not change general guard/ratio gas source meanings or complete all character build interactions.
effect_eligibility: own class, learned/allocated positive effective grade under existing气功学习与秘籍 and升级发点; temporary0 suspends contribution without cancelling stored timer, no refunds. Never borrow same-name other-class branch.
